evidence.quote: The Cu-2Cr-0.3Ag and Cu-2Cr-0.3Ag-0.1Si (wt.%) alloys were fabricated by atmospheric smelting.
The studied alloys underwent homogenization (950 °C 4 h) to eradicate the compositional segregation.
Subsequently, hot rolling (HR) by 80 % was carried out at 900 °C to thin the ingots.
Following the HR, the alloys were treated in a solid solution treatment (SST, 950 °C 2 h) to re-solidify the precipitates rather than precipitation during the HR process.
